title: 中国西电 China XD Electric: 14 subsidiaries win CNY 1.447bn of State Grid procurement (transformers, switchgear, UHV equipment)
snippet: China XD Electric (中国西电) announced that 14 of its subsidiaries jointly won State Grid (国家电网) procurement tenders totaling CNY 1.447bn. The award covers power-grid equipment including transformers and switchgear, underscoring continued State Grid purchasing of high-voltage apparatus from domestic manufacturers.
src: Sina Finance 新浪财经 · 30 Dec 2025 [zh]

title: 中国西电 China XD Electric: 6 subsidiaries win CNY 1.899bn of State Grid UHV project procurement
snippet: China XD Electric said six of its subsidiaries won State Grid procurement worth CNY 1.899bn for UHV (特高压) projects. The award extends the company's streak of large grid-equipment orders, consistent with accelerating State Grid UHV and AC/DC transmission construction.
src: Dahe Cube 大河财立方 · 12 Jun 2026 [zh]

title: 平高电气 Pinggao Electric: wins CNY 876m of State Grid procurement (GIS/switchgear)
snippet: Pinggao Electric (平高电气) announced it won State Grid procurement tenders worth about CNY 876m. The listed switchgear maker's award reflects sustained State Grid spending on HV switchgear and related substation equipment.

title: 许继电气 XJ Electric: wins about CNY 1.245bn of State Grid UHV projects
snippet: XJ Electric (许继电气) disclosed it won State Grid UHV-related procurement totaling about CNY 1.245bn. The order book adds HVDC/UHV control-protection and converter-related equipment work for the State Grid network, per its voluntary disclosure announcement.
src: East Money 东方财富 · 23 Jul 2026 [zh]

title: 保变电气 Baoding Tianwei Baobian Electric wins 500kV main transformer supply for Hebei Lingshou pumped-storage station
snippet: Baobian Electric (保变电气) won the procurement of 500kV three-phase two-winding oil-immersed water-cooled power transformers for the Hebei Lingshou pumped-storage hydropower station. The order highlights demand for large power transformers in pumped-storage and grid-ancillary projects.

title: 特变电工 TBEA: bid-evaluation result for main transformers of Jinsha River upper-reach Changbo hydropower station
snippet: TBEA (特变电工) appeared in the bid-evaluation announcement for the main power transformers and auxiliary equipment of the Changbo hydropower station on the upper Jinsha River (Huadian's project). The result is a sign of large-hydro main-transformer supply going to domestic manufacturers.

title: Shanbei–Anhui ±800 kV UHVDC transmission project completed and commissioned
snippet: Xinhua reported that the Shanbei–Anhui (陕北—安徽) ±800kV ultra-high-voltage DC transmission project entered commercial operation. The line transmits northwest power to the Anhui load center, expanding the UHVDC corridor network that drives demand for converter transformers and converter-valve equipment.

title: State Grid: grid construction accelerated across all voltage levels in H1 2026
snippet: State Grid Corporation (国家电网) said grid construction at all voltage levels was accelerated in the first half of 2026. The official update signals continued heavy investment in substations, transmission lines and distribution networks — the demand backdrop for transformer, switchgear and UHV equipment makers.
src: State Grid 国家电网官网 · 21 Jul 2026 [zh]

title: German grid operators say transformers are becoming a bottleneck for grid expansion
snippet: ZfK reports that key grid components, notably transformers, are turning into a bottleneck for German grid expansion, with utilities (Stadtwerke) and distribution network operators facing long procurement lead times as reinforcement work accelerates. The article highlights how transformer supply constraints are shaping network planning and purchasing decisions.

title: Billion-euro order for an offshore wind grid-connection platform in Germany
snippet: Energynewsmagazine reports a billion-euro order for a wind-power platform in Germany, part of the country's offshore grid connection build-out. The contract underscores the scale of investment in offshore converter infrastructure needed to connect North Sea wind farms to the onshore grid.

title: Mitnetz Strom earmarks EUR 531 million for grid expansion, digitalisation and resilience in 2026
snippet: German distribution system operator Mitnetz Strom announced investments of EUR 531 million for 2026, earmarked for grid expansion, digitalisation and resilience measures. The programme reflects continued reinforcement of the German distribution network as renewable capacity and electrification grow.

title: RTE transports a transformer for the future 'Les Îles' substation by exceptional convoy
snippet: RTE carried out an exceptional heavy-transport operation to deliver a transformer for the future 'Les Îles' substation. The delivery illustrates the logistics involved in installing large power transformers as the French transmission grid is reinforced with new substations.

title: French regulator CRE approves RTE's EUR 4.24 billion investment programme for 2026
snippet: France's energy regulator CRE approved RTE's 2026 investment programme of EUR 4.24 billion, consistent with the trajectory set in the TURPE 7 transmission network tariff decision. The approval backs sustained spending on the French transmission grid, including substations and network reinforcement.

title: RHODÉ consortium launches major R&D project for floating HVDC connection of deep-water offshore wind
snippet: RTE and its partners launched the RHODÉ consortium, a major R&D project developing floating HVDC electrical connection technology for offshore wind farms in deep waters. The initiative targets grid-connection solutions for wind parks located beyond the reach of conventional bottom-fixed converter platforms.

title: TCN expands Lagos power grid with 840MVA transformer roll-out
snippet: Nigeria's Transmission Company of Nigeria (TCN) is rolling out 840MVA of transformer capacity across Lagos substations, boosting transmission capacity in the country's commercial capital. The programme is part of ongoing reinforcement of the Lagos transmission network.

title: KETRACO energises Isinya–Konza 400kV line, boosting grid reliability for Konza Technopolis
snippet: Kenya's KETRACO energised the Isinya–Konza 400kV transmission line, strengthening grid reliability and power supply to Konza Technopolis. The line adds high-voltage transmission capacity for the technopolis and the wider Lower Eastern region of Kenya.

title: GE Vernova posts $7.1 billion in electrification orders
snippet: GE Vernova reported first-quarter 2026 Electrification segment orders of $7.1 billion, up 86% organically, with a book-to-bill of about 2.5 and continued strong demand for grid equipment, including $2.4 billion of equipment orders for data centres.

title: Hitachi Energy adds USD 150m to expand power transformer manufacturing capacity in Latin America
snippet: Hitachi Energy announced an additional USD 150 million investment to expand its power transformer manufacturing capacity in Latin America, reaffirming its commitment to the region. The move targets growing demand for large power transformers amid grid expansion and renewable integration across Latin American markets.

title: Chile's Coordinador Eléctrico proposes 45 transmission expansion projects worth over USD 700m
snippet: Chile's Coordinador Eléctrico Nacional proposed 45 transmission expansion projects with an estimated investment of more than USD 700 million, part of the 2026 transmission planning cycle. The package includes new lines and substation works aimed at reinforcing the national transmission grid.

title: Red Eléctrica expands Magallón substation in Zaragoza province to reinforce Spain's transmission grid
snippet: Red Eléctrica de España is expanding the Magallón substation in Zaragoza province as part of efforts to boost industrial development and reinforce the transmission (transport) grid in the area. The project strengthens supply capacity for the surrounding region in northeastern Spain.

title: CFE strengthens northwestern Mexico's grid with new substation and transmission infrastructure
snippet: Mexico's state utility CFE is reinforcing the electrical network of the northwest with new infrastructure, including substation and transmission works. The effort is aimed at improving supply reliability in the region served by CFE's northwestern divisions.

title: Dominican Republic's EDEESTE puts new power transformer into operation at Los Minas 138 kV substation
snippet: Dominican Republic distribution utility EDEESTE commissioned a new power transformer at its Los Minas 138 kV substation. The unit is part of the distributor's program to reinforce transformation capacity and improve supply reliability in its service area.

title: Ecuador's CELEC installs new transformer raising Esmeraldas electrical capacity by 61%
snippet: Ecuador's state power company CELEC (Hidronación) installed a new transformer that increases the electrical capacity of the province of Esmeraldas by 61%. The upgrade strengthens transformation capacity in the coastal region.

title: Peru's MINEM optimizes transmission projects to reinforce national grid security and reliability
snippet: Peru's Ministry of Energy and Mines (MINEM) announced it is optimizing electrical transmission projects as part of efforts to reinforce the security and reliability of the national electricity system. The measures touch on the planning of transmission lines and related grid infrastructure.

title: Colombia's ANLA approves second environmental license modification for 500 kV La Loma–Sogamoso transmission line
snippet: Colombia's National Environmental Licensing Authority (ANLA) approved the second modification of the environmental license for the La Loma–Sogamoso 500 kV transmission line. The 500 kV project is part of Colombia's high-voltage transmission expansion to integrate generation and reinforce the national grid.

title: Terna and STEG award €770m Elmed converter-station contract to Hitachi Energy
snippet: Terna and Tunisian TSO STEG awarded Hitachi Energy the €770 million tender for the converter stations of the Elmed interconnection between Italy and Tunisia, billed as the first power link between Europe and Africa. The scope covers the HVDC converter stations, the grid-equipment core of the project, including converter transformers and power-electronics systems. The award confirms Hitachi Energy as lead supplier for the two terminal stations.

title: Tyrrhenian Link: Terna completes last of three exceptional transformer transports to Termini Imerese converter station
snippet: Terna completed the last of three exceptional (maxi) road transports of large transformers to the Termini Imerese conversion station for the Tyrrhenian Link HVDC project, which will connect Sicily, Sardinia and Campania. The oversized transformer loads had to be moved on special convoys, marking a logistics milestone for the converter-station build-out. The station is a key node of the 500 kV-class HVDC link under construction.

title: Slovenian TSO ELES and Terna sign agreement to upgrade Slovenia–Italy cross-border connection (€250m, +600 MW)
snippet: ELES and Terna signed an agreement to upgrade the electricity interconnection between Slovenia and Italy along the Divača–Sredipolje–Padriče corridor, with coverage reporting an investment of about €250 million and roughly 600 MW of additional transfer capacity. The upgrade is aimed at grid resilience and more stable operation of both transmission systems. It represents a cross-border grid-reinforcement program in which Terna acts as co-investor with a neighbouring TSO.

title: CPFL Paulista invests over R8m to expand and modernize Piracicaba 2 substation
snippet: CPFL Paulista invested more than R8 million in the expansion and modernization of the Piracicaba 2 substation in São Paulo state, increasing the energy capacity available to the region. Substation works of this type typically include replacement or addition of power transformers, bays and protection equipment. The project is part of CPFL's distribution-grid reinforcement program in the interior of São Paulo.

title: Terna: €1.5bn of grid investments in H1 2026 (+19.8%), with a record second quarter (+41.3%)
snippet: Terna reported €1.5 billion of investments in the first half of 2026, up 19.8% year-on-year, with the second quarter setting a record (+41.3%), according to its interim results. The capex is largely directed at developing and reinforcing the national transmission grid, including new lines, stations and HVDC links. The figure confirms acceleration of Terna's multi-year investment plan on electricity infrastructure.

title: Terna starts authorization process for €80m grid interventions in Milan province
snippet: Terna launched the authorization process for interventions on the electricity transmission network in the province of Milan, with an investment of about €80 million. The works target the renewal and reinforcement of the transmission network serving the metropolitan area. The announcement is part of Terna's ongoing program to upgrade high-voltage infrastructure around major Italian cities.

title: Terna launches authorization process for a new electrical substation in Pisa province
snippet: Terna started the authorization process for building a new electrical substation in the province of Pisa, a project aimed at strengthening the regional transmission grid. The new station is intended to improve network resilience and support the connection of new generation in the area. The authorization route involves the Italian Ministry of the Environment and Energy Security (MASE).

title: Terna brings new eastern Sicily connection into service, completing the Paternò–Pantano–Priolo line
snippet: Terna made operational a new connection that strengthens the electricity grid of eastern Sicily, with Quotidiano Energia reporting completion of the new Paternò–Pantano–Priolo line. The infrastructure increases redundancy and supply security for the area. The commissioning is part of Terna's regional transmission investments in Sicily.

title: Toshiba Energy Systems wins HVDC order to renew Pole 1 of J-Power Transmission Network's Hokkaido–Honshu link
snippet: Toshiba Energy Systems & Solutions (東芝エネルギーシステムズ) received an order from J-Power group's 電源開発送変電ネットワーク for the renewal of Pole 1 of the Hokkaido–Honshu interconnection, covering design, procurement and installation of self-commutated AC/DC converter equipment comprising converters, transformers and control/protection devices. The ~167 km HVDC link (600 MW total, 300 MW per pole) between Hakodate and Kamikita converter stations has operated since 1979. Equipment delivery starts from FY2029, with operation planned during FY2031.
src: 東芝エネルギーシステムズ ニュースリリース · 16 Mar 2026 [ja]

title: Toshiba Energy Systems to invest ~JPY 55bn in transmission/distribution equipment output; Hamakawasaki and India capacity to double by FY2030
snippet: Toshiba Energy Systems & Solutions announced ~JPY 55bn of production investment in its transmission/distribution equipment business through FY2027 — about JPY 35bn on top of the ~JPY 20bn announced in July 2024 — targeting its Hamakawasaki Works (Kawasaki) and Indian subsidiary TTDI. Production capacity at both sites is to more than double by FY2030 versus FY2024. The expansion covers transformers, switchgear and arresters, citing grid renewal, renewables expansion and data-center demand.
src: 東芝エネルギーシステムズ ニュースリリース · 17 Oct 2025 [ja]

title: Hitachi Energy announces record ~JPY 48bn China investment to expand transformer capacity at Hefei subsidiary
snippet: Hitachi Energy (日立エナジー) announced on 17 Aug 2026 a strategic investment of about USD 300 million (~JPY 48bn) in China — described as its largest single investment in the country — at its Hefei transformer subsidiary, marked by completion of a digital tap-changer production line and groundbreaking of an ultra-high-voltage bushing project. The investment extends its power transformer business and component manufacturing to strengthen its global supply network amid surging transformer demand.

title: Daido Japan wins distribution transformer orders at JECA FAIR 2026 with 2026 Top Runner-compliant T-NEX series
snippet: Daido Japan (大同日本, a TATUNG subsidiary) exhibited at JECA FAIR 2026 (the 74th electrical installation industry fair, May 2026) and announced its T-NEX high-efficiency mold transformer series conforming to Japan's 2026 Top Runner transformer standard, while disclosing it won multiple distribution transformer orders before and after the fair. The company cites rapidly rising demand for high-efficiency equipment ahead of full enforcement of the 2026 Top Runner standard.

title: Hokkaido Electric Power Network (北電ネット) to build new substations in Ishikari and Tomakomai for data-center demand
snippet: Hokkaido Electric Power Network plans to construct new substations in Ishikari and Tomakomai to accommodate rising electricity demand from data centers entering the region. The substation build-out is part of the utility's grid infrastructure response to load growth.
src: 北海道新聞デジタル · 30 Mar 2026 [ja]

title: Grid council (広域機関) sets Chugoku–Kyushu transmission reinforcement plan, targeting March 2039 operation
snippet: The Organization for Cross-regional Coordination of Transmission Operators (電力広域的運営推進機関) formulated a plan to reinforce the Chugoku–Kyushu transmission interconnection (中国九州間連系設備), aiming for operation start in March 2039. The plan was filed with METI in mid-October 2025 as a wide-area grid development plan (広域系統整備計画), underpinning cross-regional grid investment.
src: 中国新聞デジタル · 15 Oct 2025 [ja]

title: TEPCO Power Grid solicits land for 500 kV substations in Tokyo, Ibaraki and Chiba to serve data-center demand
snippet: Tokyo Electric Power Grid (東電PG) began soliciting land for new substations — EHV substations (275–500 kV/154 kV) around Tsukuba, Ibaraki and Kashiwa, Chiba, plus intermediate and distribution substations near central Tokyo stations — as a second solicitation round following December 2024. The company plans to build 2–3 new 500 kV/154 kV substations by 2040, enabling acceptance of 6–9 GW of additional data-center and industrial demand.
value: 500 kV/154 kV · 6–9 GW DC demand by 2040

title: Hitachi to invest over JPY 150bn in US, including new transformer plant for data centers
snippet: Nikkei reports Hitachi is investing more than JPY 150bn in the United States, including a new transformer plant oriented to data-center demand. The move reflects growing US power-equipment demand and transformer supply tightness.

title: LS Electric wins ~KRW 100bn ultra-high-voltage transformer order from US big-tech client
snippet: Yonhap reports LS Electric (LS일렉트릭) secured an ultra-high-voltage (EHV) transformer order worth about KRW 100bn from a major US technology company. The deal extends the Korean equipment maker's exposure to AI-driven US data-center power demand and adds to its transformer backlog. The customer and delivery terms were not disclosed.

title: Iljin Electric wins KRW 120bn EHV transformer order for Canadian data centers
snippet: Iljin Electric (일진전기) announced a transformer supply contract worth about KRW 120bn for Canadian data centers, per Yonhap. The order underscores the trend of Korean power-equipment makers capturing AI/data-center-driven demand in North America.

title: HD Hyundai Electric raises 2026 order target 23% to about KRW 8tn on global grid demand
snippet: HD Hyundai Electric (HD현대일렉트릭) lifted its 2026 order target by about 23% to roughly KRW 8tn, citing strong global demand for power infrastructure tied to AI and electrification, per Donga Bizn. Transformer and switchgear backlogs continue to expand as US and European grid investment rises.

title: KEPCO to build third transmission line and undersea grid link for Incheon Yeongjong after blackouts
snippet: After large-scale blackouts on Incheon's Yeongjong Island, KEPCO (한국전력) is pushing ahead with a third transmission line plus an undersea transmission route, with about KRW 35.4bn to be invested, per Yonhap and Herald Economy coverage. The reinforcement adds redundancy to the island's power supply after repeated outage incidents.

title: Astor Enerji signs TRY 816.2m contract with TEİAŞ after grid tender win
snippet: Turkish transformer maker Astor Enerji signed a TRY 816.2m contract following a TEİAŞ tender award, reported by Enerji Günlüğü and Petroturk in early July 2026. The deal adds to Astor's order book from Türkiye's grid operator amid ongoing network expansion.

title: Hitachi Energy inaugurates USD 70m power transformer factory and service center in Dilovası, Türkiye
snippet: Hitachi Energy opened a new power transformer factory and service center in Dilovası, Kocaeli, backed by a USD 70m investment, per the company's Turkish-language press release. The facility strengthens Türkiye's transformer manufacturing base for domestic supply and exports.

title: TEİAŞ publishes 2,000 MWe of transformer-based unlicensed generation capacity for 2026
snippet: TEİAŞ published its 2026 allocation of a total 2,000 MWe of unlicensed electricity generation capacity to be assigned at distribution level on a transformer basis, announced via GENSED. The scheme ties new distributed-generation connections to available transformer capacity at substations.

title: Egypt's electricity minister: EGP 37bn for developing and upgrading the transmission grid
snippet: Egyptian Electricity Minister Mahmoud Esmat announced EGP 37bn of investments to support, develop and modernize the transmission network and raise its capacity to absorb new renewable generation, per Masrawy. The program targets grid reinforcement as renewables and new capacity connect to the system.

title: China Southern Power Grid opens a negotiation to prototype a 10 kV distribution transformer on waste-cooking-oil insulating fluid
snippet: China Southern Power Grid supply-chain notice CG0300062002414753, published 14 October 2026 at 17:36, invites negotiation for Guangzhou Xinzhi Energy Technology to design, build and test a 10 kV distribution transformer using vegetable insulating oil refined from waste cooking oil. The notice states an estimated amount of CNY 600,000. Responses are due 21 October 2026; that deadline is not the publication date. Original notice in Chinese.
src: 南方电网供应链统一服务平台 · 14 Oct 2026 [zh]

title: Delta Electronics shows a working 800 VDC solid-state transformer at Energy Taiwan
snippet: TechNews, published 14 October 2026 at 16:43, reports that Delta Electronics displayed a prefabricated solid-state transformer converting medium-voltage AC to 800 V DC at Energy Taiwan 2026, with a stated conversion efficiency of 98.5 percent. China Times reported the same demonstration the same day. The data-centre scheme is in customer testing, not a utility award. Original reports in Traditional Chinese.

title: Weiguang Energy says it led four Chinese group standards for solid-state transformers
snippet: Century New Energy Network, timestamped 14 October 2026 at 09:36, reports that group standards T/CEATEC 249-2026 to 252-2026 for solid-state transformers were recently released under the China-Europe Association for Economic and Technical Cooperation, covering PV grid connection, data centres, AC/DC distribution and EV ultra-fast charging. The article dates the report; it does not print a separate issue date for the standards. Delivery counts in the piece are the company's statements. Original in Chinese.

title: TEDAŞ notice: expropriation for power lines and transformer buildings in Kahramanmaraş
snippet: Yeniçağ Gazetesi printed this notice at 00:01 on 14 October 2026. TEDAŞ 3rd Regional Directorate says expropriation is underway for parcels in Kahramanmaraş that power lines and transformer-building sites fall on, under Electricity Market Law 6446. The board decisions that opened the process date from 2021 through 2025; 14 October is the newspaper date of the notice, not a new board decision. Owners have 15 days from the notice to seek a settlement. Original in Turkish.

title: GCC–Oman direct electrical interconnection project launches with USD 700m funding
snippet: The direct electrical interconnection project between the GCC grid and Oman was launched with USD 700m in financing, strengthening Gulf energy security and integration, per Asharq Al-Awsat. The link expands cross-border transmission capacity between the GCCIA network and Oman's power system.

title: Sadales tīkls seeks mobile 630 kVA transformer substations
snippet: TED notice 712579-2026, published 15 October 2026, is a contract notice from Latvian distribution operator Sadales tīkls for the supply of mobile transformer substations rated 630 kVA. The notice states an estimated value of EUR 220,771.70. Tenders are due 5 November 2026 at 10:00 (UTC+2). It does not state how many units. Original notice in Latvian.

title: ŽĎAS tenders a 110 kV switchyard rebuild with two 110/22/6.3 kV transformers
snippet: TED notice 711752-2026, published 15 October 2026, invites bids to rebuild the existing 110 kV ŽĎAS switchyard, including supply, installation and commissioning of two 110/22/6.3 kV transformers. The buyer is ŽĎAS, a.s. Offers are due 21 October 2026 at 10:00 (UTC+2). The notice fields retrieved do not state a contract value. Original notice in Czech.

title: Mondragon solar project tenders floating transformer substations
snippet: TED notice 713576-2026, published 15 October 2026, is supply lot 3 (PTR) from Centrale solaire de Mondragon (CSMOD2) for the supply and on-site delivery of floating transformer substations. Requests to participate are due 16 October 2026 at 23:59 (UTC+2). The notice fields retrieved do not state a unit count or a contract value. Original notice in French.

title: PSE tenders expansion of the 400/110 kV Czarna substation
snippet: TED notice 711561-2026, published 15 October 2026, is a works contract from Polish transmission operator PSE to expand the 400/110 kV Czarna substation at Czerniec, in the Lubin municipality, so new facilities can connect to the national grid. The scope covers new construction and rebuilding of conflicting structures, including busbar bridges. Offers are due 27 October 2026 at 10:00 (UTC+1). No estimated value was in the notice fields retrieved. Original notice in Polish.

title: Augstsprieguma tīkls tenders a rebuild of 110 kV substation No. 6 TEC-1
snippet: TED notice 712707-2026, published 15 October 2026, invites bids to rebuild substation No. 6 TEC-1, covering the 110 kV relay protection and control systems, including design, construction and equipment supply. The buyer is Latvian transmission operator Augstsprieguma tīkls. Offers are due 3 November 2026 at 10:00 (UTC+2). No estimated value was in the notice fields retrieved. Original notice in Latvian.

title: PSE tenders 110/220/400 kV disconnectors and earthing switches, stage IV-A
snippet: TED notice 713886-2026, published 15 October 2026, is a supplies contract from PSE for new disconnectors and earthing switches for 110 kV, 220 kV and 400 kV transmission substations. It is split into four packages: pantograph disconnectors; horizontal-break disconnectors and free-standing earthing switches; vertical-break disconnectors; and disconnectors for the Wielopole substation. Offers are due 28 October 2026 at 10:00 (UTC+1). No estimated value was in the notice fields retrieved. Original notice in Polish.

title: Distribuție Energie Oltenia tenders 123 kV breaker modules for a 110 kV line bay and a transformer bay
snippet: TED notice 711669-2026, published 15 October 2026, is a contract from Distribuție Energie Oltenia to buy, design, install and commission 123 kV, 31.5 kA COMPASS breaker modules. The work modernizes the 110 kV Preajba line bay and transformer-2 bay, and a breaker module at the 110/20 kV Harlesti substation in Trivalea-Mosteni, Teleorman. The notice states RON 4,772,200. Offers are due 17 November 2026 at 11:00 (UTC+2). Original notice in Romanian.

title: Red Eléctrica awards a 400 kV GIS bay at Santa María de Grado to Siemens Energy
snippet: TED award notice 711925-2026, published 15 October 2026, records that Red Eléctrica de España awarded the supply and installation of one 400 kV GIS bay at the Santa María de Grado substation in Asturias to Siemens Energy S.A. The notice fields retrieved do not state the contract value. Original notice in Spanish.

title: Red Eléctrica awards three 220 kV GIS bays to Siemens Energy
snippet: TED award notice 713963-2026, published 15 October 2026, records that Red Eléctrica de España awarded the supply and installation of three 220 kV gas-insulated switchgear bays to Siemens Energy S.A. The notice fields retrieved do not state the contract value or name the substation. Original notice in Spanish.

title: Hyosung Heavy Industries opens an export ultra-high-voltage circuit-breaker plant in Changwon
snippet: Hyosung Heavy Industries' own newsroom, dated 16 October 2026, says the company completed an export-only ultra-high-voltage circuit-breaker plant at its Changwon works that day. The same notice says the company has invested USD 300 million to date in its Memphis works and that an expansion there is still underway. That Memphis figure is background in this notice, not a new order dated 16 October. The Changwon plant is about 18,996 square metres and is dedicated to 420 kV, 550 kV and 800 kV breakers. The notice says production capacity for breakers rated 420 kV and above, and for insulation components, is about double the previous level. Original in Korean.

title: HD Hyundai Electric agrees a data-centre power memorandum with LG CNS
snippet: iNews24, timestamped 10:02 on 16 October 2026, reports that HD Hyundai Electric said it signed a mutual-cooperation memorandum with LG CNS on 15 October at the HD Hyundai Global R&D Center in Seongnam. The agreement covers packaged supply of power and distribution equipment for AI data centres, joint marketing, and linking HD Hyundai Electric's power-monitoring platform with LG CNS data tools. It also describes later pilot work at the Cheongju distribution campus. The article states no contract value, equipment rating, or award. Original in Korean.

title: Prague Castle records extra works on the replacement of 12 distribution transformers
snippet: TED modification notice 718420-2026, published 16 October 2026, amends the Prague Castle Administration contract to replace 12 distribution transformers rated 22/0.4 kV in five substations on the castle grounds. The notice states additional works worth CZK 1,338,566.10 excluding VAT, for painting and minor repairs found after shutdown, control-system cabling, busbar extensions, earthing, and replacement of damaged incoming cables. It also extends completion to 30 November 2026. The notice's value of all contracts awarded is CZK 14,185,163.10. The contractor remains MERCATOR, s.r.o. The original award decision and contract date are earlier; 16 October is the publication date of this modification. Original notice in Czech.

title: wesernetz Bremen seeks a full electrical rebuild of the Hemelingen 110 kV substation
snippet: TED notice 715980-2026, published 16 October 2026, is a negotiated competition from wesernetz Bremen GmbH to renew the Hemelingen substation inside the existing building. The scope covers removal of the present electrical plant and supply, installation and commissioning of a new 110 kV switchgear, a new 10 kV switchgear, a new 0.4 kV switchboard, DC auxiliary supply, protection and control, and associated cabling. It is split into a 110 kV switchgear lot and a lot for the 10 kV and 0.4 kV gear, batteries and electrical installation. Requests to participate are due 20 November 2026 at 18:00 (UTC+1). The notice fields retrieved do not state a contract value, and they do not name a transformer replacement. Original notice in German.

title: Stadtwerke Saarbrücken Netz awards a 10 kV switchgear for substation BBH to NATUS
snippet: TED award notice 718522-2026, published 16 October 2026, records that Stadtwerke Saarbrücken Netz AG awarded the supply of a 10 kV switchgear for substation UW BBH to NATUS GmbH & Co. KG. The notice states a contract value of EUR 1,596,280. Two tenders were received. The contract was concluded on 29 April 2026; 16 October is the publication date of the award notice, not the award date. The notice does not state a transformer rating. Original notice in German.

title: PSE tenders stage IX of its transformer-population renewal
snippet: TED contract notice 718912-2026, published 19 October 2026, is from Polskie Sieci Elektroenergetyczne. The notice title is the modernisation of the transformer population, stage IX. It asks for design, manufacture or purchase, delivery and installation of devices it labels AT, with monitoring, at the buyer's substations. Package I is 2 units at substation Norki. Offers are due 5 February 2027 at 12:00 (UTC+1). Package II is 7 units at Wigry (2), Kromolice (1), Blachownia (2) and Podborze (2), with offers due 5 March 2027 at 12:00 (UTC+1). Package III is 4 units at Baczyna (1), Tarnów (2) and Wielopole (1), with offers due 5 February 2027 at 12:00 (UTC+1). The notice does not state a contract value or a rating in MVA. Original notice in Polish.

title: GIZ tenders 630 kVA transformers for south-east Ukraine
snippet: TED contract notice 720408-2026, published 19 October 2026, is from Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH. Each of three lots is the supply of 630 kVA transformers on Incoterm DPU to south-east Ukraine. The notice says the exact addresses are given to the winning bidder after award. Offers are due 3 November 2026 at 12:00 (UTC+1). The notice does not state how many units. Original notice in German.

title: Statnett asks the market about power-transformer and shunt-reactor specialists
snippet: TED prior-information notice 720247-2026, published 19 October 2026, is a market assessment from Statnett SF. It asks whether suppliers can provide highly experienced technical specialists for power transformers and shunt reactors on transmission systems. The notice is not a call for tenders. It states no contract value and no offer deadline. The notice text retrieved is in English.

title: Rīgas satiksme tenders medium-voltage transformers, with rectifiers, for two traction substations
snippet: TED contract notice 721851-2026, published 19 October 2026, invites supply of medium-voltage transformers and rectifiers for traction substations No. 6 and No. 28. The buyer is Rīgas satiksme. Offers are due 19 November 2026 at 10:00 (UTC+2). The notice fields retrieved do not state a contract value or a unit rating. Original notice in Latvian.

title: CEA tenders replacement and addition of HV/LV transformer-substation equipment
snippet: TED contract notice 721936-2026, published 19 October 2026, is from the Commissariat à l'énergie atomique et aux énergies alternatives for works to replace, remove or add the equipment that makes up high-voltage/low-voltage transformer substations. Requests to participate are due 17 November 2026 at 17:30 (UTC+1). The notice fields retrieved do not state a contract value. Original notice in French.

title: PGE Dystrybucja tenders mobile MV/LV transformer stations
snippet: TED contract notice 722261-2026, published 19 October 2026, is a supplies contract from PGE Dystrybucja S.A. for mobile MV/LV transformer stations built on trailers or transport chassis. Offers are due 28 October 2026 at 11:00 (UTC+1). The lot description retrieved says only that the scope follows the specification. It does not state a unit count or a contract value. Original notice in Polish.

title: DEER awards oil-immersed distribution transformers to Eximprod Power Systems
snippet: TED award notice 722551-2026, published 19 October 2026, records that Distribuție Energie Electrică Romania S.A. awarded a supply agreement for three-phase oil-immersed sealed low-loss distribution transformers to Eximprod Power Systems. The lots are 20/0.4 kV, 6/0.4 kV and 10/0.4 kV. The notice states a total value of RON 6,274,773.51. It also states estimated values of RON 23,250,525, RON 355,860 and RON 157,414 for the three lots, and caps the largest subsequent contract at RON 4,547,122, RON 177,930 and RON 78,707. The notice lists contract conclusion dates of 9 April 2025, 14 May 2025, 5 August 2025, 25 August 2026 and 12 October 2026. 19 October is the publication date of this award notice. Original notice in Romanian.

title: TU Braunschweig tenders replacement of two 250 kVA transformers with 630 kVA units
snippet: TED contract notice 722593-2026, published 19 October 2026, is from Technische Universität Braunschweig. It covers rebuilding and upgrading transformer station 34/34 so the new physics building can be supplied. The scope is replacement of two 250 kVA transformers with two 630 kVA transformers, adaptation of the medium-voltage switchgear, two extra 1,000 A outgoing panels on the low-voltage main distribution, renewal of the transformer cables including about 320 m of 1x240 mm² low-voltage cable, and the related tests and commissioning. Offers are due 2 November 2026 at 11:00 (UTC+1). The notice fields retrieved do not state a contract value. Original notice in German.

title: EDF tenders a fire-protection changeover for power transformers at Martigues
snippet: TED contract notice 719807-2026, published 19 October 2026, is a four-year agreement from EDF SA to change the fire protection of the power transformers at CETAC and the Martigues combined-cycle plant. The scope is a move to solutions without foam, or to foams that meet the European regulation, including supply, studies, works, tests and industrial commissioning. Offers are due 16 November 2026 at 12:00 (UTC+1). The notice fields retrieved do not state a contract value. Original notice in French.

title: Mainzer Netze tenders renewal and expansion of the Hechtsheim 110 kV substation
snippet: TED contract notice 719289-2026, published 19 October 2026, is from Mainzer Netze GmbH for construction to renew and expand the Hechtsheim substation and to rebuild the connected 110 kV overhead lines Bretzenheim–Hechtsheim and Hechtsheim–Laubenheim. The substation lot covers renewal and expansion of the 110 kV switchgear, a new operations building, secondary systems, auxiliary supply and dismantling. The line lot covers about 1.5 km and eight existing towers. Offers are due 20 November 2026 at 12:00 (UTC+1). The notice does not name a transformer replacement. Original notice in German.

title: CORPOELEC starts installation of a 300 MVA autotransformer at the Portuguesa 400 kV substation
snippet: CORPOELEC's own newsroom, dated 18 October 2026, says the utility moved a 300 MVA autotransformer to the Portuguesa 400 kV substation in Páez municipality after a road move of more than 35 hours. Crews have started seating the unit, assembling accessories and treating the dielectric oil. Insulation tests, protection calibration and functional checks are still to be done before the unit is energised. The notice says the unit is meant to improve voltage profiles on transmission lines linking Barinas, Portuguesa, Táchira, Mérida, Trujillo and Alto Apure. Original in Spanish.

title: HD Hyundai Electric transformers reported at National Grid Didcot, with Hitachi Energy switchgear
snippet: The Guru, timestamped 07:00 on 18 October 2026, reports that three HD Hyundai Electric 460 MVA transformers, the last of them weighing 213 tonnes and moved by Collett & Sons, have all arrived at National Grid's Didcot substation extension in Oxfordshire. The article attributes that arrival to industry sources. It says the project adds the three transformers at the existing 400 kV substation and builds a 132 kV GIS substation on adjacent land, using Hitachi Energy switchgear, to connect two new data centres and 650 MW of battery storage. It says construction runs until early 2029, with Linxon as the main contractor. The article states no new order value dated 18 October. Original in Korean.

title: LS Electric discloses a KRW 168.9bn switchboard supply for a 2027 US data-centre project
snippet: Seoul Economic Daily's disclosure page, timestamped 09:30 on 19 October 2026, reproduces an LS Electric filing provided by KOSCOM. The filing names a supply contract, titled as the 2027 North America data-centre power-equipment supply project, worth KRW 168,871,711,050, stated as USD 125,229,300 at KRW 1,348.50 per dollar. The counterparty is LS ELECTRIC AMERICA Inc., a subsidiary. The filing says the parent is supplying switchboards for a US hyperscale data-centre project held by the subsidiary, and that this purchase order, dated 16 October 2026, is the 2027 delivery following a 2026 portion of USD 114,974,772 disclosed on 13 April 2026. The contract end date on the filing is 31 December 2027. It does not name the data-centre customer or a transformer rating. Original in Korean.

title: Baiyun Electric presents a 2.5 MW solid-state transformer supply for AI data centres
snippet: China Securities Journal, timestamped 16:54 on 18 October 2026, reports that Baiyun Electric held a launch in Guangzhou on 16 October 2026 for a 2.5 MW solid-state-transformer power system aimed at AI computing centres. The article, citing the company, says the prefabricated system converts 10 kV AC to 800 V DC in one stage. It also says the company reached cooperation arrangements at the event with a Tsinghua University laboratory, Guangdong Telecom Planning and Design Institute, and Fengzhushou. It states no order value. Original in Chinese.

title: Tengen Electric's first solid-state transformer leaves the production line at a Yueqing seminar
snippet: Wenzhou Daily, timestamped 10:08 on 19 October 2026, reports that the second national solid-state transformer seminar opened on 16 October 2026 in Liushi, Yueqing. The article says that on the same day Tengen Electric (天正电气) brought its first self-developed solid-state transformer off a mass-production line. It does not state a rating, a customer or an order value. Original in Chinese.

title: ENEA Wytwarzanie awards a 400/30/30 kV, 280/140/140 MVA transformer to EthosEnergy Poland
snippet: TED award notice 724398-2026, published 20 October 2026, records that ENEA Wytwarzanie sp. z o.o. awarded the supply of a 400/30/30 kV transformer rated 280/140/140 MVA for the MEE ELKO I electricity-storage project at its site in Świerże Górne to EthosEnergy Poland S.A. The notice states a total value of PLN 26,000,000 and an estimated value of PLN 28,000,000. One tender was received. The award decision date on the notice is 1 September 2026 and the contract conclusion date is 15 October 2026. 20 October is the publication date of this award notice. Original notice in Polish.

title: Ignitis tenders two 110/10/10 kV, 40 MVA power transformers and adjusts the application deadline
snippet: TED contract notice 724627-2026, published 20 October 2026, is from UAB Ignitis grupės paslaugų centras for the purchase of two 110/10/10 kV, 40 MVA power transformers (reference 2026-ESO-942). The notice says the application deadline was adjusted. Requests are due 26 October 2026 at 10:00 (UTC+3). The value fields retrieved are 0 EUR. Original notice in Lithuanian.

title: PSE tenders transformer-population renewal stage IX, titled Niedofinansowane
snippet: TED contract notice 724922-2026, published 20 October 2026, is from Polskie Sieci Elektroenergetyczne. The notice title is the modernisation of the transformer population, stage IX, and includes the word Niedofinansowane. It asks for design, manufacture or purchase, delivery and installation of devices it labels AT, with monitoring, at the buyer's substations. Package I is substations Wypędy, Poręba and Boguchwała; offers are due 5 March 2027 at 12:00 (UTC+1). Package II is Witonia and Biebrowo; offers are due 4 May 2027 at 12:00 (UTC+2). Package III is Jarosław Systemowa, Miękinia, Gdańsk Błonia and Ołtarzew; offers are due 30 November 2026 at 12:00 (UTC+1). Package IV is Miłosna, CPK, Bydgoszcz, Dmosin, Kozienice and Ostrów Wielkopolski; offers are due 18 December 2026 at 12:00 (UTC+1). Package V is Byczyna, Ostrowiec and Tucznawa; offers are due 4 June 2027 at 12:00 (UTC+2). Package VI is Dmosin and Ołtarzew; offers are due 2 April 2027 at 12:00 (UTC+2). The notice does not state a contract value, a unit count or a rating in MVA. Original notice in Polish.

title: ŽĎAS tenders reconstruction of its 110 kV switchyard, including two 110/22/6.3 kV transformers
snippet: TED contract notice 722850-2026, published 20 October 2026, is from ŽĎAS, a.s. The scope is reconstruction of the existing R110 kV ŽĎAS switchyard, civil and technology works, including supply, installation and commissioning of two 110/22/6.3 kV transformers. Requests are due 27 October 2026 at 10:00 (UTC+1). A change note on the notice points to an explanation of the tender documents because answers to questions were late. The notice fields retrieved do not state a contract value. Original notice in Czech.

title: Stadtwerke Konstanz tenders general planning for a new 110/20 kV substation at Hafner
snippet: TED contract notice 725901-2026, published 20 October 2026, is from Stadtwerke Konstanz GmbH for general planning of a new substation for the Hafner district. The notice says the substation connects on the primary side to the utility's 110 kV ring cable and on the outgoing side as a 20 kV distribution node for the new district and the suburbs. The planning scope it lists includes two 110/20 kV transformers, 110 kV, 20 kV and 0.4 kV switchgear, and the related building and secondary systems. Requests to participate are due 20 November 2026 at 12:00 (UTC+1). The notice also lists a lot deadline of 13 November 2026 at 23:59 (UTC+1). The fields retrieved do not label that second deadline. The notice fields retrieved do not state a contract value. Original notice in German.

title: FMV tenders 65/16.5 kV transformers for the new Ernen substation
snippet: TED contract notice 726241-2026, published 20 October 2026, is from FMV SA for the new Ernen substation. The scope is one 65/16.5 kV transformer rated 25 MVA ONAN and at least 32 MVA ONAF, plus an identical second transformer to be offered as an option. Offers are due 30 November 2026 at 23:59 (UTC+1). The notice fields retrieved do not state a contract value. Original notice in French.

title: EG.D awards 110/23 kV oil power transformers to ETD Transformátory a.s. and KONČAR D&ST
snippet: TED award notice 725978-2026, published 20 October 2026, records that EG.D, s.r.o. awarded the supply of three-phase oil-immersed 110/23 kV power transformers with accessories. The notice names ETD TRANSFORMÁTORY a.s. and KONČAR D&ST. It states a total value of CZK 18,852,714, an estimated lot value of CZK 16,137,000, and tender values of CZK 18,852,714 and 0. The fields retrieved do not label which tender value belongs to which winner. Two tenders were received. The award decision date on the notice is 28 August 2026 and the contract conclusion dates are 30 September 2026. 20 October is the publication date of this award notice. Original notice in Czech.

title: EG.D awards 22/0.4 kV distribution transformers to Elpro-Energo, Trafo CZ and BEZ Transformátory
snippet: TED award notice 726046-2026, published 20 October 2026, records that EG.D, s.r.o. awarded the supply of hermetically sealed three-phase oil distribution transformers, 22/0.4 kV, rated up to 630 kVA, with accessories. The notice names Elpro – Energo s.r.o., Trafo CZ, a.s. and BEZ TRANSFORMÁTORY, a.s. It states a total value of CZK 60,783,937 and tender values of CZK 21,277,458, CZK 33,269,730 and CZK 6,236,749. The fields retrieved do not label which tender value belongs to which winner. Six tenders were received. The award decision date on the notice is 31 October 2024 and the contract conclusion dates are 30 September 2026. 20 October is the publication date of this award notice. Original notice in Czech.
awardee: Elpro – Energo s.r.o.; Trafo CZ, a.s.; BEZ TRANSFORMÁTORY, a.s.

title: EG.D awards outdoor MV instrument transformers to KPB INTRA
snippet: TED award notice 724334-2026, published 20 October 2026, records that EG.D, s.r.o. awarded the supply of outdoor single-phase, two-pole insulated MV instrument transformers for overhead lines with a highest system voltage of at least 25 kV, for feeding low-voltage sources. The notice names KPB INTRA s.r.o. It states a total value and a tender value of CZK 624,000, and an estimated lot value of CZK 36,000,000. One tender was received. The award decision date on the notice is 11 September 2025 and the contract conclusion date is 30 September 2026. 20 October is the publication date of this award notice. Original notice in Czech.

title: EG.D awards HV instrument transformers to Kones CZ
snippet: TED award notice 725869-2026, published 20 October 2026, records that EG.D, s.r.o. awarded the supply of HV instrument transformers. The notice names Kones CZ s.r.o. It states a total value of CZK 644,099, a tender value of CZK 21,122,023 and an estimated lot value of CZK 750,000. The fields retrieved do not explain the difference between those figures. Four tenders were received. The award decision date on the notice is 21 December 2023 and the contract conclusion date is 30 September 2026. 20 October is the publication date of this award notice. Original notice in Czech.

title: EG.D awards arc-suppression coils and resistors to EGE
snippet: TED award notice 725126-2026, published 20 October 2026, records that EG.D, s.r.o. awarded the supply of continuously tunable arc-suppression coils, secondary resistors and neutral (primary) resistors, with defined accessories. The notice names EGE, spol. s r.o. It states a total value and a tender value of CZK 1,625,000, and an estimated lot value of CZK 99,000,000. The notice does not describe a power transformer. One tender was received. The award decision date on the notice is 13 October 2025 and the contract conclusion date is 30 September 2026. 20 October is the publication date of this award notice. Original notice in Czech.

title: Guangdong Power Grid suspends the 35 kV switchgear and aerial-work-vehicle lots in a package that also covers 20 kV box transformers
snippet: China Southern Power Grid supply-chain notice, published 20 October 2026 at 10:00, says the Guangdong Power Grid 2026 special tender (number CG0300022002375049) for 20 kV box transformers, 35 kV simplified-station 35 kV switchgear and aerial work vehicles has failed for two lots. The failed lots are the 35 kV switchgear package 1 and the aerial-work-vehicle package 1, because too few bids passed the preliminary review. The notice suspends those lots and says a re-tender, if any, will be published later. It does not say the 20 kV box-transformer lot failed. The tender agent named on the notice is China Southern Power Grid Supply Chain (Guangdong) Co., Ltd. Original notice in Chinese.
